name: add-dtrack-project-version
description: Add a new version to a Dependency-Track project, carrying over audit history and settings from the previous latest version, before uploading a BOM.
instanceNameFormat: Add Dependency Track project version $(dtrackProjVersion) for $(dtrackProjName)
author: Edouard Shaar

inputs.name: dtrackProjName
inputs.label: Project Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: The name of the project in Dependency Track.

inputs.name: dtrackProjVersion
inputs.label: Project Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: The version of the project to add in Dependency Track. If a project with this name and version already exists, this task is a no-op.

inputs.name: dtrackIsLatest
inputs.label: Is Latest Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Sets the new project version as the latest version. Defaults to FALSE.

inputs.name: serviceConnection
inputs.label: Service Connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Dependency Track service connection. This is used to set the Dependency Track URI and API Key. If this is set, the Dependency Track URI and API Key inputs will be ignored.

inputs.name: dtrackAPIKey
inputs.label: API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Dependency Track API key. This is used to authenticate to Dependency Track. Required if Service Connection is not specified.

inputs.name: dtrackURI
inputs.label: Dependency Track URI
inputs.helpMarkDown: The URL to the Dependency Track platform. Required if Service Connection is not specified.

inputs.name: dtrackAddVersionTags
inputs.label: Add Tags
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls whether tags are carried over from the previous latest version to the new version.

inputs.name: dtrackAddVersionProperties
inputs.label: Add Properties
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls whether project properties are carried over from the previous latest version to the new version.

inputs.name: dtrackAddVersionServices
inputs.label: Add Services
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls whether services are carried over from the previous latest version to the new version.

inputs.name: dtrackAddVersionACL
inputs.label: Add ACL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls whether the portfolio access control list is carried over from the previous latest version to the new version.

inputs.name: dtrackAddVersionComponents
inputs.label: Add Components
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls whether components are carried over from the previous latest version to the new version.

inputs.name: dtrackAddVersionFindings
inputs.label: Add Findings
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls whether findings are carried over from the previous latest version to the new version. Has no effect unless Add Components is also enabled.

inputs.name: dtrackAddVersionAuditHistory
inputs.label: Add Findings Audit History
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls whether findings audit history (e.g. analysis decisions such as 'not affected' or 'false positive') is carried over from the previous latest version to the new version. Has no effect unless Add Findings is also enabled.

inputs.name: dtrackAddVersionPolicyViolations
inputs.label: Add Policy Violations
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls whether policy violations are carried over from the previous latest version to the new version. Has no effect unless Add Components is also enabled.

inputs.name: dtrackAddVersionPolicyViolationsAuditHistory
inputs.label: Add Policy Violations Audit History
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls whether policy violation audit history is carried over from the previous latest version to the new version. Has no effect unless Add Policy Violations is also enabled.

inputs.name: caFilePath
inputs.label: Trusted CA certificate
inputs.helpMarkDown: File path to PEM encoded CA certificate. This setting is used when Dependency Track is using a self-signed certificate or an internal CA provider for it's TLS configuration.

messages.FileNotFound: File path is not a file: %s
messages.PollingFailed: Polling Dependency Track for update Failed: %s
messages.GetProjectUuidStarting: Getting project id using name '%s' and version '%s'.
messages.MissingProjectInfo: Project name and version are required.
messages.GetVersionFailed: Failed to determine Dependency Track version: %s
messages.AddingVersion: Project '%s' version '%s' will be used as the basis for new version '%s', carrying over its settings and audit history.
messages.AddVersionSucceed: Adding the new project version succeeded. New project id: '%s'.
messages.AddVersionFailed: Adding the new project version failed: %s
messages.ProjectAlreadyExists: Project '%s' version '%s' already exists (id: '%s'). Nothing to do.
messages.NoPreviousVersionToAdd: No previous version of project '%s' was found to add version '%s' from. Nothing to do.
